 1: package com.idugalic.apigateway;
 2: import org.springframework.boot.SpringApplication;
 3: import org.springframework.boot.autoconfigure.SpringBootApplication;
 4: import org.springframework.cloud.client.discovery.EnableDiscoveryClient;
 5: import org.springframework.cloud.netflix.hystrix.EnableHystrix;
 6: import org.springframework.cloud.netflix.zuul.EnableZuulProxy;
 7: import org.springframework.context.annotation.Bean;
 8: import org.springframework.context.annotation.Configuration;
 9: import org.springframework.data.domain.AuditorAware;
10: import org.springframework.security.config.annotation.web.builders.HttpSecurity;
11: import org.springframework.security.core.Authentication;
12: import org.springframework.security.core.context.SecurityContextHolder;
13: import org.springframework.security.oauth2.config.annotation.web.configuration.EnableResourceServer;
14: import org.springframework.security.oauth2.config.annotation.web.configuration.ResourceServerConfigurerAdapter;
15: @SpringBootApplication
16: @EnableDiscoveryClient
17: @EnableZuulProxy
18: @EnableResourceServer
19: @EnableHystrix
20: public class Application {
21:     public static void main(String[] args) {
22:         SpringApplication.run(Application.class, args);
23:     }
24:     @Bean
25:     public AuditorAware<String> auditorAware() {
26:         return new AuditorAware<String>() {
27:             public String getCurrentAuditor() {
28:                 Authentication authentication = SecurityContextHolder.getContext().getAuthentication();
29:                 if (authentication == null || !authentication.isAuthenticated()) {
30:                     return null;
31:                 }
32:                 return authentication.getName();
33:             }
34:         };
35:     }
36:     @Configuration
37:     public static class RestSecurityConfig extends ResourceServerConfigurerAdapter {
38:         @Override
39:         public void configure(HttpSecurity http) throws Exception {
40:             http.requestMatchers().and().authorizeRequests().antMatchers("/**").permitAll();
41:         }
42:     }
43: }

File: api-gateway/src/main/java/com/idugalic/apigateway/configuration/RabbitConfiguration.java
================
 1: package com.idugalic.apigateway.configuration;
 2: import org.axonframework.amqp.eventhandling.DefaultAMQPMessageConverter;
 3: import org.axonframework.amqp.eventhandling.spring.SpringAMQPMessageSource;
 4: import org.axonframework.serialization.Serializer;
 5: import org.springframework.amqp.core.AmqpAdmin;
 6: import org.springframework.amqp.core.Binding;
 7: import org.springframework.amqp.core.FanoutExchange;
 8: import org.springframework.amqp.core.Message;
 9: import org.springframework.amqp.core.Queue;
10: import org.springframework.amqp.rabbit.annotation.RabbitListener;
11: import org.springframework.amqp.rabbit.connection.CachingConnectionFactory;
12: import org.springframework.amqp.rabbit.connection.ConnectionFactory;
13: import org.springframework.beans.factory.annotation.Autowired;
14: import org.springframework.beans.factory.annotation.Value;
15: import org.springframework.context.annotation.Bean;
16: import org.springframework.context.annotation.Configuration;
17: import org.springframework.context.annotation.Profile;
18: import com.rabbitmq.client.Channel;
19: @Configuration
20: public class RabbitConfiguration {
21:     @Value("${spring.rabbitmq.hostname}")
22:     private String hostname;
23:     @Value("${spring.rabbitmq.username}")
24:     private String username;
25:     @Value("${spring.rabbitmq.password}")
26:     private String password;
27:     @Value("${spring.application.queue}")
28:     private String queueName;
29:     @Value("${spring.application.blog.exchange}")
30:     private String blogExchangeName;
31:     @Value("${spring.application.project.exchange}")
32:     private String projectExchangeName;
33:     @Bean
34:     Queue eventStream() {
35:         return new Queue(queueName, true);
36:     }
37:     @Bean
38:     FanoutExchange blogEventBusExchange() {
39:         return new FanoutExchange(blogExchangeName, true, false);
40:     }
41:     @Bean
42:     Binding blogBinding() {
43:         return new Binding(queueName, Binding.DestinationType.QUEUE, blogExchangeName, "*.*", null);
44:     }
45:     @Bean
46:     FanoutExchange projectEventBusExchange() {
47:         return new FanoutExchange(projectExchangeName, true, false);
48:     }
49:     @Bean
50:     Binding projectBinding() {
51:         return new Binding(queueName, Binding.DestinationType.QUEUE, projectExchangeName, "*.*", null);
52:     }
53:     @Profile("!cloud")
54:     @Bean
55:     ConnectionFactory connectionFactory() {
56:         CachingConnectionFactory connectionFactory = new CachingConnectionFactory(hostname);
57:         connectionFactory.setUsername(username);
58:         connectionFactory.setPassword(password);
59:         return connectionFactory;
60:     }
61:     @Autowired
62:     void rabbitAdmin(AmqpAdmin admin, ConnectionFactory connectionFactory) {
63:         admin.declareExchange(blogEventBusExchange());
64:         admin.declareQueue(eventStream());
65:         admin.declareBinding(blogBinding());
66:         admin.declareExchange(projectEventBusExchange());
67:         admin.declareBinding(projectBinding());
68:     }
69:     @Bean
70:     public SpringAMQPMessageSource messageSourceApiGateway(Serializer serializer) {
71:         return new SpringAMQPMessageSource(new DefaultAMQPMessageConverter(serializer)) {
72:             @RabbitListener(queues = "${spring.application.queue}")
73:             @Override
74:             public void onMessage(Message message, Channel channel) throws Exception {
75:                 super.onMessage(message, channel);
76:             }
77:         };
78:     }
79: }

File: api-gateway/src/main/java/com/idugalic/apigateway/handler/EventLoggingHandler.java
================
 1: package com.idugalic.apigateway.handler;
 2: import com.idugalic.common.blog.event.BlogPostCreatedEvent;
 3: import com.idugalic.common.blog.event.BlogPostPublishedEvent;
 4: import com.idugalic.common.event.AuditableAbstractEvent;
 5: import com.idugalic.common.project.event.ProjectCreatedEvent;
 6: import com.idugalic.common.project.event.ProjectUpdatedEvent;
 7: import org.axonframework.config.ProcessingGroup;
 8: import org.axonframework.eventhandling.EventHandler;
 9: import org.slf4j.Logger;
10: import org.slf4j.LoggerFactory;
11: import org.springframework.beans.factory.annotation.Autowired;
12: import org.springframework.messaging.simp.SimpMessageSendingOperations;
13: import org.springframework.stereotype.Component;
14: @ProcessingGroup("default")
15: @Component
16: public class EventLoggingHandler {
17:     private static final Logger LOG = LoggerFactory.getLogger(EventLoggingHandler.class);
18:     private static final String IID = String.valueOf(Double.valueOf(Math.random() * 100).intValue());
19:     @Autowired
20:     private SimpMessageSendingOperations messagingTemplate;
21:     private void publish(String username, AuditableAbstractEvent event, String queue) {
22:         LOG.debug("IID:{} ET:{} EID:[{}] is published via WebSocket", IID, event.getClass().getSimpleName(), event.getId());
23:         this.messagingTemplate.convertAndSend(queue, event);
24:     }
25:     @EventHandler
26:     public void handleBlogCreate(BlogPostCreatedEvent event) {
27:         publish(event.getAuditEntry().getWho(), event, "/queue/blog");
28:     }
29:     @EventHandler
30:     public void handleBlogPublis(BlogPostPublishedEvent event) {
31:         publish(event.getAuditEntry().getWho(), event, "/queue/blog");
32:     }
33:     @EventHandler
34:     public void handleProjectCreate(ProjectCreatedEvent event) {
35:         publish(event.getAuditEntry().getWho(), event, "/queue/project");
36:     }
37:     @EventHandler
38:     public void handleProjectUpdate(ProjectUpdatedEvent event) {
39:         publish(event.getAuditEntry().getWho(), event, "/queue/project");
40:     }
41: }

 337:         var proto = protos.shift();

 536: AbstractXHRObject.prototype._start = function(method, url, payload, opts) {
 537:     var that = this;
 538:     try {
 539:         that.xhr = new XMLHttpRequest();
 540:     } catch(x) {};

 544:         } catch(x) {};
 545:     }

 547:         url += ((url.indexOf('?') === -1) ? '?' : '&') + 't='+(+new Date);
 548:     }

 550:     try {
 551:         that.xhr.open(method, url, true);
 552:     } catch(e) {
 553:         that.emit('finish', 0, '');
 554:         that._cleanup();
 555:         return;
 556:     };
 557:     if (!opts || !opts.no_credentials) {
 558:         // Mozilla docs says https://developer.mozilla.org/en/XMLHttpRequest :
 559:         // "This never affects same-site requests."
 560:         that.xhr.withCredentials = 'true';
 561:     }
 562:     if (opts && opts.headers) {
 563:         for(var key in opts.headers) {
 564:             that.xhr.setRequestHeader(key, opts.headers[key]);
 565:         }
 566:     }

 568:         if (that.xhr) {
 569:             var x = that.xhr;
 570:             switch (x.readyState) {
 571:             case 3:
 572:                 try {
 573:                     var status = x.status;
 574:                     var text = x.responseText;
 575:                 } catch (x) {};
 576:                 if (status === 1223) status = 204;
 577:                 if (text && text.length > 0) {
 578:                     that.emit('chunk', status, text);
 579:                 }
 580:                 break;
 581:             case 4:
 582:                 var status = x.status;
 583:                 if (status === 1223) status = 204;
 584:                 that.emit('finish', status, x.responseText);
 585:                 that._cleanup(false);
 586:                 break;
 587:             }
 588:         }
 589:     };
 590:     that.xhr.send(payload);
 591: };

 767: SockJS.prototype._didClose = function(code, reason, force) {
 768:     var that = this;
 769:     if (that.readyState !== SockJS.CONNECTING &&
 770:         that.readyState !== SockJS.OPEN &&
 771:         that.readyState !== SockJS.CLOSING)
 772:             throw new Error('INVALID_STATE_ERR');
 773:     if (that._ir) {
 774:         that._ir.nuke();
 775:         that._ir = null;
 776:     }
 777:     if (that._transport) {
 778:         that._transport.doCleanup();
 779:         that._transport = null;
 780:     }
 781:     var close_event = new SimpleEvent("close", {
 782:         code: code,
 783:         reason: reason,
 784:         wasClean: utils.userSetCode(code)});
 785:     if (!utils.userSetCode(code) &&
 786:         that.readyState === SockJS.CONNECTING && !force) {
 787:         if (that._try_next_protocol(close_event)) {
 788:             return;
 789:         }
 790:         close_event = new SimpleEvent("close", {code: 2000,
 791:                                                 reason: "All transports failed",
 792:                                                 wasClean: false,
 793:                                                 last_event: close_event});
 794:     }
 795:     that.readyState = SockJS.CLOSED;
 796:     utils.delay(function() {
 797:                    that.dispatchEvent(close_event);
 798:                 });
 799: };
 800: SockJS.prototype._didMessage = function(data) {
 801:     var that = this;
 802:     var type = data.slice(0, 1);
 803:     switch(type) {
 804:     case 'o':
 805:         that._dispatchOpen();
 806:         break;
 807:     case 'a':
 808:         var payload = JSON.parse(data.slice(1) || '[]');
 809:         for(var i=0; i < payload.length; i++){
 810:             that._dispatchMessage(payload[i]);
 811:         }
 812:         break;
 813:     case 'm':
 814:         var payload = JSON.parse(data.slice(1) || 'null');
 815:         that._dispatchMessage(payload);
 816:         break;
 817:     case 'c':
 818:         var payload = JSON.parse(data.slice(1) || '[]');
 819:         that._didClose(payload[0], payload[1]);
 820:         break;
 821:     case 'h':
 822:         that._dispatchHeartbeat();
 823:         break;
 824:     }
 825: };
 826: SockJS.prototype._try_next_protocol = function(close_event) {
 827:     var that = this;
 828:     if (that.protocol) {
 829:         that._debug('Closed transport:', that.protocol, ''+close_event);
 830:         that.protocol = null;
 831:     }
 832:     if (that._transport_tref) {
 833:         clearTimeout(that._transport_tref);
 834:         that._transport_tref = null;
 835:     }
 836:     while(1) {
 837:         var protocol = that.protocol = that._protocols.shift();
 838:         if (!protocol) {
 839:             return false;
 840:         }
 841:         // Some protocols require access to `body`, what if were in
 842:         // the `head`?
 843:         if (SockJS[protocol] &&
 844:             SockJS[protocol].need_body === true &&
 845:             (!_document.body ||
 846:              (typeof _document.readyState !== 'undefined'
 847:               && _document.readyState !== 'complete'))) {
 848:             that._protocols.unshift(protocol);
 849:             that.protocol = 'waiting-for-load';
 850:             utils.attachEvent('load', function(){
 851:                 that._try_next_protocol();
 852:             });
 853:             return true;
 854:         }
 855:         if (!SockJS[protocol] ||
 856:               !SockJS[protocol].enabled(that._options)) {
 857:             that._debug('Skipping transport:', protocol);
 858:         } else {
 859:             var roundTrips = SockJS[protocol].roundTrips || 1;
 860:             var to = ((that._options.rto || 0) * roundTrips) || 5000;
 861:             that._transport_tref = utils.delay(to, function() {
 862:                 if (that.readyState === SockJS.CONNECTING) {
 863:                     that._didClose(2007, "Transport timeouted");
 864:                 }
 865:             });
 866:             var connid = utils.random_string(8);
 867:             var trans_url = that._base_url + '/' + that._server + '/' + connid;
 868:             that._debug('Opening transport:', protocol, ' url:'+trans_url,
 869:                         ' RTO:'+that._options.rto);
 870:             that._transport = new SockJS[protocol](that, trans_url,
 871:                                                    that._base_url);
 872:             return true;
 873:         }
 874:     }
 875: };
 876: SockJS.prototype.close = function(code, reason) {
 877:     var that = this;
 878:     if (code && !utils.userSetCode(code))
 879:         throw new Error("INVALID_ACCESS_ERR");
 880:     if(that.readyState !== SockJS.CONNECTING &&
 881:        that.readyState !== SockJS.OPEN) {
 882:         return false;
 883:     }
 884:     that.readyState = SockJS.CLOSING;
 885:     that._didClose(code || 1000, reason || "Normal closure");
 886:     return true;
 887: };
 888: SockJS.prototype.send = function(data) {
 889:     var that = this;
 890:     if (that.readyState === SockJS.CONNECTING)
 891:         throw new Error('INVALID_STATE_ERR');
 892:     if (that.readyState === SockJS.OPEN) {
 893:         that._transport.doSend(utils.quote('' + data));
 894:     }
 895:     return true;
 896: };

417:     },
418:     Frame: Frame
419:   };
420:   if (typeof window !== "undefined" && window !== null) {
421:     Stomp.setInterval = function(interval, f) {
422:       return window.setInterval(f, interval);
423:     };
424:     Stomp.clearInterval = function(id) {
425:       return window.clearInterval(id);
426:     };
427:     window.Stomp = Stomp;
428:   } else if (typeof exports !== "undefined" && exports !== null) {
429:     exports.Stomp = Stomp;
430:   } else {
431:     self.Stomp = Stomp;
432:   }
433: }).call(this);

File: authserver/src/main/java/com/idugalic/authserver/AuthserverApplication.java

 1: package com.idugalic.authserver;
 2: import java.security.KeyPair;
 3: import org.springframework.beans.factory.annotation.Autowired;
 4: import org.springframework.beans.factory.annotation.Qualifier;
 5: import org.springframework.boot.SpringApplication;
 6: import org.springframework.boot.autoconfigure.EnableAutoConfiguration;
 7: import org.springframework.context.annotation.Bean;
 8: import org.springframework.context.annotation.ComponentScan;
 9: import org.springframework.context.annotation.Configuration;
10: import org.springframework.core.io.ClassPathResource;
11: import org.springframework.security.authentication.AuthenticationManager;
12: import org.springframework.security.config.annotation.authentication.builders.AuthenticationManagerBuilder;
13: import org.springframework.security.config.annotation.web.builders.HttpSecurity;
14: import org.springframework.security.config.annotation.web.configuration.WebSecurityConfigurerAdapter;
15: import org.springframework.security.oauth2.config.annotation.configurers.ClientDetailsServiceConfigurer;
16: import org.springframework.security.oauth2.config.annotation.web.configuration.AuthorizationServerConfigurerAdapter;
17: import org.springframework.security.oauth2.config.annotation.web.configuration.EnableAuthorizationServer;
18: import org.springframework.security.oauth2.config.annotation.web.configurers.AuthorizationServerEndpointsConfigurer;
19: import org.springframework.security.oauth2.config.annotation.web.configurers.AuthorizationServerSecurityConfigurer;
20: import org.springframework.security.oauth2.provider.token.store.JwtAccessTokenConverter;
21: import org.springframework.security.oauth2.provider.token.store.KeyStoreKeyFactory;
22: import org.springframework.stereotype.Controller;
23: import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.SessionAttributes;
24: import org.springframework.web.servlet.config.annotation.ViewControllerRegistry;
25: import org.springframework.web.servlet.config.annotation.WebMvcConfigurerAdapter;
26: @Configuration
27: @ComponentScan
28: @EnableAutoConfiguration
29: @Controller
30: @SessionAttributes("authorizationRequest")
31: public class AuthserverApplication extends WebMvcConfigurerAdapter {
32:     public static void main(String[] args) {
33:         SpringApplication.run(AuthserverApplication.class, args);
34:     }
35:     @Override
36:     public void addViewControllers(ViewControllerRegistry registry) {
37:         registry.addViewController("/login").setViewName("login");
38:         registry.addViewController("/oauth/confirm_access").setViewName("authorize");
39:     }
40:     @Configuration
41:     protected static class WebSecurityConfig extends WebSecurityConfigurerAdapter {
42:         @Override
43:         protected void configure(HttpSecurity http) throws Exception {
44:             http.formLogin().loginPage("/login").permitAll().and().authorizeRequests()
45:                     .anyRequest().authenticated();
46:         }
47:         @Override
48:         protected void configure(AuthenticationManagerBuilder auth) throws Exception {
49:             auth.inMemoryAuthentication().withUser("idugalic").roles("ADMIN").password("idugalic").and().withUser("odugalic").roles("USER").password("odugalic");
50:         }
51:         @Override
52:         @Bean
53:         public AuthenticationManager authenticationManagerBean() throws Exception {
54:             return super.authenticationManagerBean();
55:         }
56:     }
57:     @Configuration
58:     @EnableAuthorizationServer
59:     protected static class OAuth2Config extends AuthorizationServerConfigurerAdapter {
60:         @Autowired
61:         @Qualifier("authenticationManagerBean")
62:         private AuthenticationManager authenticationManager;
63:         @Bean
64:         public JwtAccessTokenConverter jwtAccessTokenConverter() {
65:             JwtAccessTokenConverter converter = new JwtAccessTokenConverter();
66:             KeyPair keyPair = new KeyStoreKeyFactory(
67:                     new ClassPathResource("keystore.jks"), "foobar".toCharArray())
68:                             .getKeyPair("test");
69:             converter.setKeyPair(keyPair);
70:             return converter;
71:         }
72:         @Override
73:         public void configure(ClientDetailsServiceConfigurer clients) throws Exception {
74:             clients.inMemory()
75:                     .withClient("acme")
76:                     .secret("acmesecret")
77:                     .authorities("CLIENT")
78:                     .authorizedGrantTypes("authorization_code", "refresh_token", "client_credentials",
79:                             "password").scopes("openid", "read_catalog", "write_catalog", "read_orders", "write_orders", "read_reviews", "write_reviews", "read_recommendations",
80:                                     "write_recommendations");
81:         }
82:         @Override
83:         public void configure(AuthorizationServerEndpointsConfigurer endpoints)
84:                 throws Exception {
85:             endpoints.authenticationManager(authenticationManager).accessTokenConverter(
86:                     jwtAccessTokenConverter());
87:         }
88:         @Override
89:         public void configure(AuthorizationServerSecurityConfigurer oauthServer)
90:                 throws Exception {
91:             oauthServer.tokenKeyAccess("permitAll()").checkTokenAccess(
92:                     "isAuthenticated()");
93:         }
94:     }
95: }

  1: #!/bin/sh
  2: # ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
  3: # Licensed to the Apache Software Foundation (ASF) under one
  4: # or more contributor license agreements.  See the NOTICE file
  5: # distributed with this work for additional information
  6: # regarding copyright ownership.  The ASF licenses this file
  7: # to you under the Apache License, Version 2.0 (the
  8: # "License"); you may not use this file except in compliance
  9: # with the License.  You may obtain a copy of the License at
 10: #
 11: #    http://www.apache.org/licenses/LICENSE-2.0
 12: #
 13: # Unless required by applicable law or agreed to in writing,
 14: # software distributed under the License is distributed on an
 15: # "AS IS" BASIS, WITHOUT WARRANTIES OR CONDITIONS OF ANY
 16: # KIND, either express or implied.  See the License for the
 17: # specific language governing permissions and limitations
 18: # under the License.
 19: # ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 20: 
 21: # ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 22: # Maven2 Start Up Batch script
 23: #
 24: # Required ENV vars:
 25: # ------------------
 26: #   JAVA_HOME - location of a JDK home dir
 27: #
 28: # Optional ENV vars
 29: # -----------------
 30: #   M2_HOME - location of maven2's installed home dir
 31: #   MAVEN_OPTS - parameters passed to the Java VM when running Maven
 32: #     e.g. to debug Maven itself, use
 33: #       set MAVEN_OPTS=-Xdebug -Xrunjdwp:transport=dt_socket,server=y,suspend=y,address=8000
 34: #   MAVEN_SKIP_RC - flag to disable loading of mavenrc files
 35: # ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 36: 
 37: if [ -z "$MAVEN_SKIP_RC" ] ; then
 38: 
 39:   if [ -f /etc/mavenrc ] ; then
 40:     . /etc/mavenrc
 41:   fi
 42: 
 43:   if [ -f "$HOME/.mavenrc" ] ; then
 44:     . "$HOME/.mavenrc"
 45:   fi
 46: 
 47: fi
 48: 
 49: # OS specific support.  $var _must_ be set to either true or false.
 50: cygwin=false;
 51: darwin=false;
 52: mingw=false
 53: case "`uname`" in
 54:   CYGWIN*) cygwin=true ;;
 55:   MINGW*) mingw=true;;
 56:   Darwin*) darwin=true
 57:            #
 58:            # Look for the Apple JDKs first to preserve the existing behaviour, and then look
 59:            # for the new JDKs provided by Oracle.
 60:            #
 61:            if [ -z "$JAVA_HOME" ] && [ -L /System/Library/Frameworks/JavaVM.framework/Versions/CurrentJDK ] ; then
 62:              #
 63:              # Apple JDKs
 64:              #
 65:              export JAVA_HOME=/System/Library/Frameworks/JavaVM.framework/Versions/CurrentJDK/Home
 66:            fi
 67: 
 68:            if [ -z "$JAVA_HOME" ] && [ -L /System/Library/Java/JavaVirtualMachines/CurrentJDK ] ; then
 69:              #
 70:              # Apple JDKs
 71:              #
 72:              export JAVA_HOME=/System/Library/Java/JavaVirtualMachines/CurrentJDK/Contents/Home
 73:            fi
 74: 
 75:            if [ -z "$JAVA_HOME" ] && [ -L "/Library/Java/JavaVirtualMachines/CurrentJDK" ] ; then
 76:              #
 77:              # Oracle JDKs
 78:              #
 79:              export JAVA_HOME=/Library/Java/JavaVirtualMachines/CurrentJDK/Contents/Home
 80:            fi
 81: 
 82:            if [ -z "$JAVA_HOME" ] && [ -x "/usr/libexec/java_home" ]; then
 83:              #
 84:              # Apple JDKs
 85:              #
 86:              export JAVA_HOME=`/usr/libexec/java_home`
 87:            fi
 88:            ;;
 89: esac
 90: 
 91: if [ -z "$JAVA_HOME" ] ; then
 92:   if [ -r /etc/gentoo-release ] ; then
 93:     JAVA_HOME=`java-config --jre-home`
 94:   fi
 95: fi
 96: 
 97: if [ -z "$M2_HOME" ] ; then
 98:   ## resolve links - $0 may be a link to maven's home
 99:   PRG="$0"
100: 
101:   # need this for relative symlinks
102:   while [ -h "$PRG" ] ; do
103:     ls=`ls -ld "$PRG"`
104:     link=`expr "$ls" : '.*-> \(.*\)$'`
105:     if expr "$link" : '/.*' > /dev/null; then
106:       PRG="$link"
107:     else
108:       PRG="`dirname "$PRG"`/$link"
109:     fi
110:   done
111: 
112:   saveddir=`pwd`
113: 
114:   M2_HOME=`dirname "$PRG"`/..
115: 
116:   # make it fully qualified
117:   M2_HOME=`cd "$M2_HOME" && pwd`
118: 
119:   cd "$saveddir"
120:   # echo Using m2 at $M2_HOME
121: fi
122: 
123: # For Cygwin, ensure paths are in UNIX format before anything is touched
124: if $cygwin ; then
125:   [ -n "$M2_HOME" ] &&
126:     M2_HOME=`cygpath --unix "$M2_HOME"`
127:   [ -n "$JAVA_HOME" ] &&
128:     JAVA_HOME=`cygpath --unix "$JAVA_HOME"`
129:   [ -n "$CLASSPATH" ] &&
130:     CLASSPATH=`cygpath --path --unix "$CLASSPATH"`
131: fi
132: 
133: # For Migwn, ensure paths are in UNIX format before anything is touched
134: if $mingw ; then
135:   [ -n "$M2_HOME" ] &&
136:     M2_HOME="`(cd "$M2_HOME"; pwd)`"
137:   [ -n "$JAVA_HOME" ] &&
138:     JAVA_HOME="`(cd "$JAVA_HOME"; pwd)`"
139:   # TODO classpath?
140: fi
141: 
142: if [ -z "$JAVA_HOME" ]; then
143:   javaExecutable="`which javac`"
144:   if [ -n "$javaExecutable" ] && ! [ "`expr \"$javaExecutable\" : '\([^ ]*\)'`" = "no" ]; then
145:     # readlink(1) is not available as standard on Solaris 10.
146:     readLink=`which readlink`
147:     if [ ! `expr "$readLink" : '\([^ ]*\)'` = "no" ]; then
148:       if $darwin ; then
149:         javaHome="`dirname \"$javaExecutable\"`"
150:         javaExecutable="`cd \"$javaHome\" && pwd -P`/javac"
151:       else
152:         javaExecutable="`readlink -f \"$javaExecutable\"`"
153:       fi
154:       javaHome="`dirname \"$javaExecutable\"`"
155:       javaHome=`expr "$javaHome" : '\(.*\)/bin'`
156:       JAVA_HOME="$javaHome"
157:       export JAVA_HOME
158:     fi
159:   fi
160: fi
161: 
162: if [ -z "$JAVACMD" ] ; then
163:   if [ -n "$JAVA_HOME"  ] ; then
164:     if [ -x "$JAVA_HOME/jre/sh/java" ] ; then
165:       # IBM's JDK on AIX uses strange locations for the executables
166:       JAVACMD="$JAVA_HOME/jre/sh/java"
167:     else
168:       JAVACMD="$JAVA_HOME/bin/java"
169:     fi
170:   else
171:     JAVACMD="`which java`"
172:   fi
173: fi
174: 
175: if [ ! -x "$JAVACMD" ] ; then
176:   echo "Error: JAVA_HOME is not defined correctly." >&2
177:   echo "  We cannot execute $JAVACMD" >&2
178:   exit 1
179: fi
180: 
181: if [ -z "$JAVA_HOME" ] ; then
182:   echo "Warning: JAVA_HOME environment variable is not set."
183: fi
184: 
185: CLASSWORLDS_LAUNCHER=org.codehaus.plexus.classworlds.launcher.Launcher
186: 
187: # For Cygwin, switch paths to Windows format before running java
188: if $cygwin; then
189:   [ -n "$M2_HOME" ] &&
190:     M2_HOME=`cygpath --path --windows "$M2_HOME"`
191:   [ -n "$JAVA_HOME" ] &&
192:     JAVA_HOME=`cygpath --path --windows "$JAVA_HOME"`
193:   [ -n "$CLASSPATH" ] &&
194:     CLASSPATH=`cygpath --path --windows "$CLASSPATH"`
195: fi
196: 
197: # traverses directory structure from process work directory to filesystem root
198: # first directory with .mvn subdirectory is considered project base directory
199: find_maven_basedir() {
200:   local basedir=$(pwd)
201:   local wdir=$(pwd)
202:   while [ "$wdir" != '/' ] ; do
203:     if [ -d "$wdir"/.mvn ] ; then
204:       basedir=$wdir
205:       break
206:     fi
207:     wdir=$(cd "$wdir/.."; pwd)
208:   done
209:   echo "${basedir}"
210: }
211: 
212: # concatenates all lines of a file
213: concat_lines() {
214:   if [ -f "$1" ]; then
215:     echo "$(tr -s '\n' ' ' < "$1")"
216:   fi
217: }
218: 
219: export MAVEN_PROJECTBASEDIR=${MAVEN_BASEDIR:-$(find_maven_basedir)}
220: MAVEN_OPTS="$(concat_lines "$MAVEN_PROJECTBASEDIR/.mvn/jvm.config") $MAVEN_OPTS"
221: 
222: # Provide a "standardized" way to retrieve the CLI args that will
223: # work with both Windows and non-Windows executions.
224: MAVEN_CMD_LINE_ARGS="$MAVEN_CONFIG $@"
225: export MAVEN_CMD_LINE_ARGS
226: 
227: WRAPPER_LAUNCHER=org.apache.maven.wrapper.MavenWrapperMain
228: 
229: exec "$JAVACMD" \
230:   $MAVEN_OPTS \
231:   -classpath "$MAVEN_PROJECTBASEDIR/.mvn/wrapper/maven-wrapper.jar" \
232:   "-Dmaven.home=${M2_HOME}" "-Dmaven.multiModuleProjectDirectory=${MAVEN_PROJECTBASEDIR}" \
233:   ${WRAPPER_LAUNCHER} "$@"

  1: @REM ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
  2: @REM Licensed to the Apache Software Foundation (ASF) under one
  3: @REM or more contributor license agreements.  See the NOTICE file
  4: @REM distributed with this work for additional information
  5: @REM regarding copyright ownership.  The ASF licenses this file
  6: @REM to you under the Apache License, Version 2.0 (the
  7: @REM "License"); you may not use this file except in compliance
  8: @REM with the License.  You may obtain a copy of the License at
  9: @REM
 10: @REM    http://www.apache.org/licenses/LICENSE-2.0
 11: @REM
 12: @REM Unless required by applicable law or agreed to in writing,
 13: @REM software distributed under the License is distributed on an
 14: @REM "AS IS" BASIS, WITHOUT WARRANTIES OR CONDITIONS OF ANY
 15: @REM KIND, either express or implied.  See the License for the
 16: @REM specific language governing permissions and limitations
 17: @REM under the License.
 18: @REM ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 19: 
 20: @REM ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 21: @REM Maven2 Start Up Batch script
 22: @REM
 23: @REM Required ENV vars:
 24: @REM JAVA_HOME - location of a JDK home dir
 25: @REM
 26: @REM Optional ENV vars
 27: @REM M2_HOME - location of maven2's installed home dir
 28: @REM MAVEN_BATCH_ECHO - set to 'on' to enable the echoing of the batch commands
 29: @REM MAVEN_BATCH_PAUSE - set to 'on' to wait for a key stroke before ending
 30: @REM MAVEN_OPTS - parameters passed to the Java VM when running Maven
 31: @REM     e.g. to debug Maven itself, use
 32: @REM set MAVEN_OPTS=-Xdebug -Xrunjdwp:transport=dt_socket,server=y,suspend=y,address=8000
 33: @REM MAVEN_SKIP_RC - flag to disable loading of mavenrc files
 34: @REM ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 35: 
 36: @REM Begin all REM lines with '@' in case MAVEN_BATCH_ECHO is 'on'
 37: @echo off
 38: @REM enable echoing my setting MAVEN_BATCH_ECHO to 'on'
 39: @if "%MAVEN_BATCH_ECHO%" == "on"  echo %MAVEN_BATCH_ECHO%
 40: 
 41: @REM set %HOME% to equivalent of $HOME
 42: if "%HOME%" == "" (set "HOME=%HOMEDRIVE%%HOMEPATH%")
 43: 
 44: @REM Execute a user defined script before this one
 45: if not "%MAVEN_SKIP_RC%" == "" goto skipRcPre
 46: @REM check for pre script, once with legacy .bat ending and once with .cmd ending
 47: if exist "%HOME%\mavenrc_pre.bat" call "%HOME%\mavenrc_pre.bat"
 48: if exist "%HOME%\mavenrc_pre.cmd" call "%HOME%\mavenrc_pre.cmd"
 49: :skipRcPre
 50: 
 51: @setlocal
 52: 
 53: set ERROR_CODE=0
 54: 
 55: @REM To isolate internal variables from possible post scripts, we use another setlocal
 56: @setlocal
 57: 
 58: @REM ==== START VALIDATION ====
 59: if not "%JAVA_HOME%" == "" goto OkJHome
 60: 
 61: echo.
 62: echo Error: JAVA_HOME not found in your environment. >&2
 63: echo Please set the JAVA_HOME variable in your environment to match the >&2
 64: echo location of your Java installation. >&2
 65: echo.
 66: goto error
 67: 
 68: :OkJHome
 69: if exist "%JAVA_HOME%\bin\java.exe" goto init
 70: 
 71: echo.
 72: echo Error: JAVA_HOME is set to an invalid directory. >&2
 73: echo JAVA_HOME = "%JAVA_HOME%" >&2
 74: echo Please set the JAVA_HOME variable in your environment to match the >&2
 75: echo location of your Java installation. >&2
 76: echo.
 77: goto error
 78: 
 79: @REM ==== END VALIDATION ====
 80: 
 81: :init
 82: 
 83: set MAVEN_CMD_LINE_ARGS=%*
 84: 
 85: @REM Find the project base dir, i.e. the directory that contains the folder ".mvn".
 86: @REM Fallback to current working directory if not found.
 87: 
 88: set MAVEN_PROJECTBASEDIR=%MAVEN_BASEDIR%
 89: IF NOT "%MAVEN_PROJECTBASEDIR%"=="" goto endDetectBaseDir
 90: 
 91: set EXEC_DIR=%CD%
 92: set WDIR=%EXEC_DIR%
 93: :findBaseDir
 94: IF EXIST "%WDIR%"\.mvn goto baseDirFound
 95: cd ..
 96: IF "%WDIR%"=="%CD%" goto baseDirNotFound
 97: set WDIR=%CD%
 98: goto findBaseDir
 99: 
100: :baseDirFound
101: set MAVEN_PROJECTBASEDIR=%WDIR%
102: cd "%EXEC_DIR%"
103: goto endDetectBaseDir
104: 
105: :baseDirNotFound
106: set MAVEN_PROJECTBASEDIR=%EXEC_DIR%
107: cd "%EXEC_DIR%"
108: 
109: :endDetectBaseDir
110: 
111: IF NOT EXIST "%MAVEN_PROJECTBASEDIR%\.mvn\jvm.config" goto endReadAdditionalConfig
112: 
113: @setlocal EnableExtensions EnableDelayedExpansion
114: for /F "usebackq delims=" %%a in ("%MAVEN_PROJECTBASEDIR%\.mvn\jvm.config") do set JVM_CONFIG_MAVEN_PROPS=!JVM_CONFIG_MAVEN_PROPS! %%a
115: @endlocal & set JVM_CONFIG_MAVEN_PROPS=%JVM_CONFIG_MAVEN_PROPS%
116: 
117: :endReadAdditionalConfig
118: 
119: SET MAVEN_JAVA_EXE="%JAVA_HOME%\bin\java.exe"
120: 
121: set WRAPPER_JAR="".\.mvn\wrapper\maven-wrapper.jar""
122: set WRAPPER_LAUNCHER=org.apache.maven.wrapper.MavenWrapperMain
123: 
124: %MAVEN_JAVA_EXE% %JVM_CONFIG_MAVEN_PROPS% %MAVEN_OPTS% %MAVEN_DEBUG_OPTS% -classpath %WRAPPER_JAR% "-Dmaven.multiModuleProjectDirectory=%MAVEN_PROJECTBASEDIR%" %WRAPPER_LAUNCHER% %MAVEN_CMD_LINE_ARGS%
125: if ERRORLEVEL 1 goto error
126: goto end
127: 
128: :error
129: set ERROR_CODE=1
130: 
131: :end
132: @endlocal & set ERROR_CODE=%ERROR_CODE%
133: 
134: if not "%MAVEN_SKIP_RC%" == "" goto skipRcPost
135: @REM check for post script, once with legacy .bat ending and once with .cmd ending
136: if exist "%HOME%\mavenrc_post.bat" call "%HOME%\mavenrc_post.bat"
137: if exist "%HOME%\mavenrc_post.cmd" call "%HOME%\mavenrc_post.cmd"
138: :skipRcPost
139: 
140: @REM pause the script if MAVEN_BATCH_PAUSE is set to 'on'
141: if "%MAVEN_BATCH_PAUSE%" == "on" pause
142: 
143: if "%MAVEN_TERMINATE_CMD%" == "on" exit %ERROR_CODE%
144: 
145: exit /B %ERROR_CODE%

File: command-side-blog-service/src/main/java/com/idugalic/commandside/blog/Application.java

 1: package com.idugalic.commandside.blog;
 2: import java.net.InetAddress;
 3: import java.net.UnknownHostException;
 4: import org.slf4j.Logger;
 5: import org.slf4j.LoggerFactory;
 6: import org.springframework.boot.SpringApplication;
 7: import org.springframework.boot.autoconfigure.SpringBootApplication;
 8: import org.springframework.cloud.client.discovery.EnableDiscoveryClient;
 9: import org.springframework.core.env.Environment;
10: @SpringBootApplication
11: @EnableDiscoveryClient
12: public class Application {
13:     private static final Logger LOG = LoggerFactory.getLogger(Application.class);
14:     public static void main(String... args) throws UnknownHostException {
15:         SpringApplication app = new SpringApplication(Application.class);
16:         Environment env = app.run(args).getEnvironment();
17:         LOG.info("\n----------------------------------------------------------\n\t" +
18:                 "Application '{}' is running! Access URLs:\n\t" +
19:                 "Local: \t\thttp://127.0.0.1:{}\n\t" +
20:                 "External: \thttp://{}:{}\n----------------------------------------------------------",
21:                 env.getProperty("spring.application.name"),
22:                 env.getProperty("server.port"),
23:                 InetAddress.getLocalHost().getHostAddress(),
24:                 env.getProperty("server.port"));
25:     }
26: }

 1: package com.idugalic.commandside.blog;
 2: import com.idugalic.commandside.blog.aggregate.exception.PublishBlogPostException;
 3: import org.axonframework.commandhandling.CommandExecutionException;
 4: import org.axonframework.commandhandling.model.ConcurrencyException;
 5: import org.axonframework.messaging.interceptors.JSR303ViolationException;
 6: import org.slf4j.Logger;
 7: import org.slf4j.LoggerFactory;
 8: import org.springframework.dao.DataAccessException;
 9: import org.springframework.dao.DataIntegrityViolationException;
10: import org.springframework.dao.InvalidDataAccessApiUsageException;
11: import org.springframework.http.HttpHeaders;
12: import org.springframework.http.HttpStatus;
13: import org.springframework.http.ResponseEntity;
14: import org.springframework.http.converter.HttpMessageNotReadableException;
15: import org.springframework.security.access.AccessDeniedException;
16: import org.springframework.web.bind.MethodArgumentNotValidException;
17: import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.ControllerAdvice;
18: import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.ExceptionHandler;
19: import org.springframework.web.context.request.WebRequest;
20: import org.springframework.web.servlet.mvc.method.annotation.ResponseEntityExceptionHandler;
21: @ControllerAdvice
22: public class RestResponseEntityExceptionHandler extends ResponseEntityExceptionHandler {
23:     private static final Logger LOG = LoggerFactory.getLogger(RestResponseEntityExceptionHandler.class);
24:     public RestResponseEntityExceptionHandler() {
25:         super();
26:     }
27:     @Override
28:     protected ResponseEntity<Object> handleHttpMessageNotReadable(final HttpMessageNotReadableException ex, final HttpHeaders headers, final HttpStatus status,
29:                                                                   final WebRequest request) {
30:         final String bodyOfResponse = "HttpMessageNotReadableException";
31:         LOG.error(bodyOfResponse, ex);
32:         return handleExceptionInternal(ex, bodyOfResponse, headers, HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST, request);
33:     }
34:     @Override
35:     protected ResponseEntity<Object> handleMethodArgumentNotValid(final MethodArgumentNotValidException ex, final HttpHeaders headers, final HttpStatus status,
36:                                                                   final WebRequest request) {
37:         final String bodyOfResponse = "MethodArgumentNotValidException";
38:         LOG.error(bodyOfResponse, ex);
39:         return handleExceptionInternal(ex, bodyOfResponse, headers, HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST, request);
40:     }
41:     @ExceptionHandler({ CommandExecutionException.class })
42:     protected ResponseEntity<Object> handleCommandExecution(final RuntimeException cex, final WebRequest request) {
43:         final String bodyOfResponse = "CommandExecutionException";
44:         if (null != cex.getCause()) {
45:             LOG.error("CAUSED BY: {} {}", cex.getCause().getClass().getName(), cex.getCause().getMessage());
46:             if (cex.getCause() instanceof ConcurrencyException) {
47:                 return handleExceptionInternal(cex, bodyOfResponse + " - Concurrency issue", new HttpHeaders(), HttpStatus.CONFLICT, request);
48:             }
49:             if (cex.getCause() instanceof PublishBlogPostException) {
50:                 return handleExceptionInternal(cex, bodyOfResponse + " - " + cex.getCause().getMessage(), new HttpHeaders(), HttpStatus.CONFLICT, request);
51:             }
52:         }
53:         return handleExceptionInternal(cex, bodyOfResponse, new HttpHeaders(), HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST, request);
54:     }
55:     @ExceptionHandler({ InvalidDataAccessApiUsageException.class, DataAccessException.class })
56:     protected ResponseEntity<Object> handleConflict(final RuntimeException ex, final WebRequest request) {
57:         final String bodyOfResponse = "DataAccessException";
58:         LOG.error(bodyOfResponse, ex);
59:         return handleExceptionInternal(ex, bodyOfResponse, new HttpHeaders(), HttpStatus.CONFLICT, request);
60:     }
61:     @ExceptionHandler({ DataIntegrityViolationException.class })
62:     public ResponseEntity<Object> handleBadRequest(final DataIntegrityViolationException ex, final WebRequest request) {
63:         final String bodyOfResponse = "DataIntegrityViolationException";
64:         LOG.error(bodyOfResponse, ex);
65:         return handleExceptionInternal(ex, bodyOfResponse, new HttpHeaders(), HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST, request);
66:     }
67:     @ExceptionHandler({ NullPointerException.class, IllegalArgumentException.class, IllegalStateException.class })
68:     public ResponseEntity<Object> handleInternal(final RuntimeException ex, final WebRequest request) {
69:         final String bodyOfResponse = "Internal Error";
70:         LOG.error(bodyOfResponse, ex);
71:         return handleExceptionInternal(ex, bodyOfResponse, new HttpHeaders(), HttpStatus.INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR, request);
72:     }
73:     @ExceptionHandler({ JSR303ViolationException.class })
74:     public ResponseEntity<Object> handleValidation(final JSR303ViolationException ex, final WebRequest request) {
75:         final String bodyOfResponse = ex.getViolations().toString();
76:         LOG.error("Validation error", ex);
77:         return new ResponseEntity<Object>(bodyOfResponse, HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST);
78:     }
79:     @ExceptionHandler({ AccessDeniedException.class })
80:     public ResponseEntity<Object> handleAccessDeniedException(Exception ex, WebRequest request) {
81:         return new ResponseEntity<Object>("Access denied message here", new HttpHeaders(), HttpStatus.FORBIDDEN);
82:     }
83: }

  1: #!/bin/sh
  2: # ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
  3: # Licensed to the Apache Software Foundation (ASF) under one

 13: # Unless required by applicable law or agreed to in writing,
 14: # software distributed under the License is distributed on an
 15: # "AS IS" BASIS, WITHOUT WARRANTIES OR CONDITIONS OF ANY
 16: # KIND, either express or implied.  See the License for the
 17: # specific language governing permissions and limitations
 18: # under the License.
 19: # ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 20: 
 21: # ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 22: # Maven2 Start Up Batch script
 23: #
 24: # Required ENV vars:
 25: # ------------------
 26: #   JAVA_HOME - location of a JDK home dir
 27: #
 28: # Optional ENV vars
 29: # -----------------
 30: #   M2_HOME - location of maven2's installed home dir
 31: #   MAVEN_OPTS - parameters passed to the Java VM when running Maven
 32: #     e.g. to debug Maven itself, use
 33: #       set MAVEN_OPTS=-Xdebug -Xrunjdwp:transport=dt_socket,server=y,suspend=y,address=8000
 34: #   MAVEN_SKIP_RC - flag to disable loading of mavenrc files
 35: # ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 36: 
 37: if [ -z "$MAVEN_SKIP_RC" ] ; then
 38: 
 39:   if [ -f /etc/mavenrc ] ; then
 40:     . /etc/mavenrc
 41:   fi
 42: 
 43:   if [ -f "$HOME/.mavenrc" ] ; then
 44:     . "$HOME/.mavenrc"
 45:   fi
 46: 
 47: fi
 48: 
 49: # OS specific support.  $var _must_ be set to either true or false.
 50: cygwin=false;
 51: darwin=false;
 52: mingw=false
 53: case "`uname`" in
 54:   CYGWIN*) cygwin=true ;;
 55:   MINGW*) mingw=true;;
 56:   Darwin*) darwin=true
 57:            #
 58:            # Look for the Apple JDKs first to preserve the existing behaviour, and then look
 59:            # for the new JDKs provided by Oracle.
 60:            #
 61:            if [ -z "$JAVA_HOME" ] && [ -L /System/Library/Frameworks/JavaVM.framework/Versions/CurrentJDK ] ; then
 62:              #
 63:              # Apple JDKs
 64:              #
 65:              export JAVA_HOME=/System/Library/Frameworks/JavaVM.framework/Versions/CurrentJDK/Home
 66:            fi
 67: 
 68:            if [ -z "$JAVA_HOME" ] && [ -L /System/Library/Java/JavaVirtualMachines/CurrentJDK ] ; then
 69:              #
 70:              # Apple JDKs
 71:              #
 72:              export JAVA_HOME=/System/Library/Java/JavaVirtualMachines/CurrentJDK/Contents/Home
 73:            fi
 74: 
 75:            if [ -z "$JAVA_HOME" ] && [ -L "/Library/Java/JavaVirtualMachines/CurrentJDK" ] ; then
 76:              #
 77:              # Oracle JDKs
 78:              #
 79:              export JAVA_HOME=/Library/Java/JavaVirtualMachines/CurrentJDK/Contents/Home
 80:            fi
 81: 
 82:            if [ -z "$JAVA_HOME" ] && [ -x "/usr/libexec/java_home" ]; then
 83:              #
 84:              # Apple JDKs
 85:              #
 86:              export JAVA_HOME=`/usr/libexec/java_home`
 87:            fi
 88:            ;;
 89: esac
 90: 
 91: if [ -z "$JAVA_HOME" ] ; then
 92:   if [ -r /etc/gentoo-release ] ; then
 93:     JAVA_HOME=`java-config --jre-home`
 94:   fi
 95: fi
 96: 
 97: if [ -z "$M2_HOME" ] ; then
 98:   ## resolve links - $0 may be a link to maven's home
 99:   PRG="$0"
100: 
101:   # need this for relative symlinks
102:   while [ -h "$PRG" ] ; do
103:     ls=`ls -ld "$PRG"`
104:     link=`expr "$ls" : '.*-> \(.*\)$'`
105:     if expr "$link" : '/.*' > /dev/null; then
106:       PRG="$link"
107:     else
108:       PRG="`dirname "$PRG"`/$link"
109:     fi
110:   done
111: 
112:   saveddir=`pwd`
113: 
114:   M2_HOME=`dirname "$PRG"`/..
115: 
116:   # make it fully qualified
117:   M2_HOME=`cd "$M2_HOME" && pwd`
118: 
119:   cd "$saveddir"
120:   # echo Using m2 at $M2_HOME
121: fi
122: 
123: # For Cygwin, ensure paths are in UNIX format before anything is touched
124: if $cygwin ; then
125:   [ -n "$M2_HOME" ] &&
126:     M2_HOME=`cygpath --unix "$M2_HOME"`
127:   [ -n "$JAVA_HOME" ] &&
128:     JAVA_HOME=`cygpath --unix "$JAVA_HOME"`
129:   [ -n "$CLASSPATH" ] &&
130:     CLASSPATH=`cygpath --path --unix "$CLASSPATH"`
131: fi
132: 
133: # For Migwn, ensure paths are in UNIX format before anything is touched
134: if $mingw ; then
135:   [ -n "$M2_HOME" ] &&
136:     M2_HOME="`(cd "$M2_HOME"; pwd)`"
137:   [ -n "$JAVA_HOME" ] &&
138:     JAVA_HOME="`(cd "$JAVA_HOME"; pwd)`"
139:   # TODO classpath?
140: fi
141: 
142: if [ -z "$JAVA_HOME" ]; then
143:   javaExecutable="`which javac`"
144:   if [ -n "$javaExecutable" ] && ! [ "`expr \"$javaExecutable\" : '\([^ ]*\)'`" = "no" ]; then
145:     # readlink(1) is not available as standard on Solaris 10.
146:     readLink=`which readlink`
147:     if [ ! `expr "$readLink" : '\([^ ]*\)'` = "no" ]; then
148:       if $darwin ; then
149:         javaHome="`dirname \"$javaExecutable\"`"
150:         javaExecutable="`cd \"$javaHome\" && pwd -P`/javac"
151:       else
152:         javaExecutable="`readlink -f \"$javaExecutable\"`"
153:       fi
154:       javaHome="`dirname \"$javaExecutable\"`"
155:       javaHome=`expr "$javaHome" : '\(.*\)/bin'`
156:       JAVA_HOME="$javaHome"
157:       export JAVA_HOME
158:     fi
159:   fi
160: fi
161: 
162: if [ -z "$JAVACMD" ] ; then
163:   if [ -n "$JAVA_HOME"  ] ; then
164:     if [ -x "$JAVA_HOME/jre/sh/java" ] ; then
165:       # IBM's JDK on AIX uses strange locations for the executables
166:       JAVACMD="$JAVA_HOME/jre/sh/java"
167:     else
168:       JAVACMD="$JAVA_HOME/bin/java"
169:     fi
170:   else
171:     JAVACMD="`which java`"
172:   fi
173: fi
174: 
175: if [ ! -x "$JAVACMD" ] ; then
176:   echo "Error: JAVA_HOME is not defined correctly." >&2
177:   echo "  We cannot execute $JAVACMD" >&2
178:   exit 1
179: fi
180: 
181: if [ -z "$JAVA_HOME" ] ; then
182:   echo "Warning: JAVA_HOME environment variable is not set."
183: fi
184: 
185: CLASSWORLDS_LAUNCHER=org.codehaus.plexus.classworlds.launcher.Launcher
186: 
187: # For Cygwin, switch paths to Windows format before running java
188: if $cygwin; then
189:   [ -n "$M2_HOME" ] &&
190:     M2_HOME=`cygpath --path --windows "$M2_HOME"`
191:   [ -n "$JAVA_HOME" ] &&
192:     JAVA_HOME=`cygpath --path --windows "$JAVA_HOME"`
193:   [ -n "$CLASSPATH" ] &&
194:     CLASSPATH=`cygpath --path --windows "$CLASSPATH"`
195: fi
196: 
197: # traverses directory structure from process work directory to filesystem root
198: # first directory with .mvn subdirectory is considered project base directory
199: find_maven_basedir() {
200:   local basedir=$(pwd)
201:   local wdir=$(pwd)
202:   while [ "$wdir" != '/' ] ; do
203:     if [ -d "$wdir"/.mvn ] ; then
204:       basedir=$wdir
205:       break
206:     fi
207:     wdir=$(cd "$wdir/.."; pwd)
208:   done
209:   echo "${basedir}"
210: }
211: 
212: # concatenates all lines of a file
213: concat_lines() {
214:   if [ -f "$1" ]; then
215:     echo "$(tr -s '\n' ' ' < "$1")"
216:   fi
217: }
218: 
219: export MAVEN_PROJECTBASEDIR=${MAVEN_BASEDIR:-$(find_maven_basedir)}
220: MAVEN_OPTS="$(concat_lines "$MAVEN_PROJECTBASEDIR/.mvn/jvm.config") $MAVEN_OPTS"
221: 
222: # Provide a "standardized" way to retrieve the CLI args that will
223: # work with both Windows and non-Windows executions.
224: MAVEN_CMD_LINE_ARGS="$MAVEN_CONFIG $@"
225: export MAVEN_CMD_LINE_ARGS
226: 
227: WRAPPER_LAUNCHER=org.apache.maven.wrapper.MavenWrapperMain
228: 
229: exec "$JAVACMD" \
230:   $MAVEN_OPTS \
231:   -classpath "$MAVEN_PROJECTBASEDIR/.mvn/wrapper/maven-wrapper.jar" \
232:   "-Dmaven.home=${M2_HOME}" "-Dmaven.multiModuleProjectDirectory=${MAVEN_PROJECTBASEDIR}" \
233:   ${WRAPPER_LAUNCHER} "$@"

 20: @REM ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 21: @REM Maven2 Start Up Batch script
 22: @REM
 23: @REM Required ENV vars:
 24: @REM JAVA_HOME - location of a JDK home dir
 25: @REM
 26: @REM Optional ENV vars
 27: @REM M2_HOME - location of maven2's installed home dir
 28: @REM MAVEN_BATCH_ECHO - set to 'on' to enable the echoing of the batch commands
 29: @REM MAVEN_BATCH_PAUSE - set to 'on' to wait for a key stroke before ending
 30: @REM MAVEN_OPTS - parameters passed to the Java VM when running Maven
 31: @REM     e.g. to debug Maven itself, use
 32: @REM set MAVEN_OPTS=-Xdebug -Xrunjdwp:transport=dt_socket,server=y,suspend=y,address=8000
 33: @REM MAVEN_SKIP_RC - flag to disable loading of mavenrc files

 35: 
 36: @REM Begin all REM lines with '@' in case MAVEN_BATCH_ECHO is 'on'
 37: @echo off
 38: @REM enable echoing my setting MAVEN_BATCH_ECHO to 'on'
 39: @if "%MAVEN_BATCH_ECHO%" == "on"  echo %MAVEN_BATCH_ECHO%
 40: 
 41: @REM set %HOME% to equivalent of $HOME
 42: if "%HOME%" == "" (set "HOME=%HOMEDRIVE%%HOMEPATH%")
 43: 
 44: @REM Execute a user defined script before this one
 45: if not "%MAVEN_SKIP_RC%" == "" goto skipRcPre
 46: @REM check for pre script, once with legacy .bat ending and once with .cmd ending
 47: if exist "%HOME%\mavenrc_pre.bat" call "%HOME%\mavenrc_pre.bat"
 48: if exist "%HOME%\mavenrc_pre.cmd" call "%HOME%\mavenrc_pre.cmd"
 49: :skipRcPre
 50: 
 51: @setlocal
 52: 
 53: set ERROR_CODE=0
 54: 
 55: @REM To isolate internal variables from possible post scripts, we use another setlocal
 56: @setlocal
 57: 
 58: @REM ==== START VALIDATION ====
 59: if not "%JAVA_HOME%" == "" goto OkJHome
 60: 
 61: echo.
 62: echo Error: JAVA_HOME not found in your environment. >&2
 63: echo Please set the JAVA_HOME variable in your environment to match the >&2
 64: echo location of your Java installation. >&2
 65: echo.
 66: goto error
 67: 
 68: :OkJHome
 69: if exist "%JAVA_HOME%\bin\java.exe" goto init
 70: 
 71: echo.
 72: echo Error: JAVA_HOME is set to an invalid directory. >&2
 73: echo JAVA_HOME = "%JAVA_HOME%" >&2
 74: echo Please set the JAVA_HOME variable in your environment to match the >&2
 75: echo location of your Java installation. >&2
 76: echo.
 77: goto error
 78: 
 79: @REM ==== END VALIDATION ====
 80: 
 81: :init
 82: 
 83: set MAVEN_CMD_LINE_ARGS=%*
 84: 
 85: @REM Find the project base dir, i.e. the directory that contains the folder ".mvn".
 86: @REM Fallback to current working directory if not found.
 87: 
 88: set MAVEN_PROJECTBASEDIR=%MAVEN_BASEDIR%
 89: IF NOT "%MAVEN_PROJECTBASEDIR%"=="" goto endDetectBaseDir
 90: 
 91: set EXEC_DIR=%CD%
 92: set WDIR=%EXEC_DIR%
 93: :findBaseDir
 94: IF EXIST "%WDIR%"\.mvn goto baseDirFound
 95: cd ..
 96: IF "%WDIR%"=="%CD%" goto baseDirNotFound
 97: set WDIR=%CD%
 98: goto findBaseDir
 99: 
100: :baseDirFound
101: set MAVEN_PROJECTBASEDIR=%WDIR%
102: cd "%EXEC_DIR%"
103: goto endDetectBaseDir
104: 
105: :baseDirNotFound
106: set MAVEN_PROJECTBASEDIR=%EXEC_DIR%
107: cd "%EXEC_DIR%"
108: 
109: :endDetectBaseDir
110: 
111: IF NOT EXIST "%MAVEN_PROJECTBASEDIR%\.mvn\jvm.config" goto endReadAdditionalConfig
112: 
113: @setlocal EnableExtensions EnableDelayedExpansion
114: for /F "usebackq delims=" %%a in ("%MAVEN_PROJECTBASEDIR%\.mvn\jvm.config") do set JVM_CONFIG_MAVEN_PROPS=!JVM_CONFIG_MAVEN_PROPS! %%a
115: @endlocal & set JVM_CONFIG_MAVEN_PROPS=%JVM_CONFIG_MAVEN_PROPS%
116: 
117: :endReadAdditionalConfig
118: 
119: SET MAVEN_JAVA_EXE="%JAVA_HOME%\bin\java.exe"
120: 
121: set WRAPPER_JAR="".\.mvn\wrapper\maven-wrapper.jar""
122: set WRAPPER_LAUNCHER=org.apache.maven.wrapper.MavenWrapperMain
123: 
124: %MAVEN_JAVA_EXE% %JVM_CONFIG_MAVEN_PROPS% %MAVEN_OPTS% %MAVEN_DEBUG_OPTS% -classpath %WRAPPER_JAR% "-Dmaven.multiModuleProjectDirectory=%MAVEN_PROJECTBASEDIR%" %WRAPPER_LAUNCHER% %MAVEN_CMD_LINE_ARGS%
125: if ERRORLEVEL 1 goto error
126: goto end
127: 
128: :error
129: set ERROR_CODE=1
130: 
131: :end
132: @endlocal & set ERROR_CODE=%ERROR_CODE%
133: 
134: if not "%MAVEN_SKIP_RC%" == "" goto skipRcPost
135: @REM check for post script, once with legacy .bat ending and once with .cmd ending
136: if exist "%HOME%\mavenrc_post.bat" call "%HOME%\mavenrc_post.bat"
137: if exist "%HOME%\mavenrc_post.cmd" call "%HOME%\mavenrc_post.cmd"
138: :skipRcPost
139: 
140: @REM pause the script if MAVEN_BATCH_PAUSE is set to 'on'
141: if "%MAVEN_BATCH_PAUSE%" == "on" pause
142: 
143: if "%MAVEN_TERMINATE_CMD%" == "on" exit %ERROR_CODE%
144: 
145: exit /B %ERROR_CODE%

 1: package com.idugalic.commandside.blog.aggregate;
 2: import com.idugalic.commandside.blog.aggregate.exception.PublishBlogPostException;
 3: import com.idugalic.commandside.blog.command.CreateBlogPostCommand;
 4: import com.idugalic.commandside.blog.command.PublishBlogPostCommand;
 5: import com.idugalic.common.blog.event.BlogPostCreatedEvent;
 6: import com.idugalic.common.blog.event.BlogPostPublishedEvent;
 7: import com.idugalic.common.blog.model.BlogPostCategory;
 8: import java.util.Date;
 9: import org.axonframework.commandhandling.CommandHandler;
10: import org.axonframework.commandhandling.model.AggregateIdentifier;
11: import org.axonframework.eventsourcing.EventSourcingHandler;
12: import org.axonframework.spring.stereotype.Aggregate;
13: import org.slf4j.Logger;
14: import org.slf4j.LoggerFactory;
15: import static org.axonframework.commandhandling.model.AggregateLifecycle.apply;
16: @Aggregate
17: public class BlogPostAggregate{
18:     private static final Logger LOG = LoggerFactory.getLogger(BlogPostAggregate.class);
19:     @AggregateIdentifier
20:     private String id;
21:     private String title;
22:     private String rawContent;
23:     private String publicSlug;
24:     private Boolean draft;
25:     private Boolean broadcast;
26:     private Date publishAt;
27:     private BlogPostCategory category;
28:     private String authorId;
29:     public BlogPostAggregate() {
30:     }
31:     @CommandHandler
32:     public BlogPostAggregate(CreateBlogPostCommand command) {
33:         LOG.debug("Command: 'CreateBlogPostCommand' received.");
34:         LOG.debug("Queuing up a new BlogPostCreatedEvent for blog post '{}'", command.getId());
35:         apply(new BlogPostCreatedEvent(command.getId(), command.getAuditEntry(), command.getTitle(),
36:                 command.getRawContent(), command.getPublicSlug(), command.getDraft(), command.getBroadcast(),
37:                 command.getPublishAt(), command.getCategory(), command.getAuthorId()));
38:     }
39:     @CommandHandler
40:     public void publishBlogPost(PublishBlogPostCommand command) {
41:         LOG.debug("Command: 'PublishBlogPostCommand' received.");
42:         if (this.getDraft()) {
43:             apply(new BlogPostPublishedEvent(id, command.getAuditEntry(), command.getPublishAt()));
44:         } else {
45:             throw new PublishBlogPostException("This BlogPostAggregate (" + this.getId() + ") is not a Draft.");
46:         }
47:     }
48:     @EventSourcingHandler
49:     public void on(BlogPostCreatedEvent event) {
50:         this.id = event.getId();
51:         this.title = event.getTitle();
52:         this.rawContent = event.getRawContent();
53:         this.publicSlug = event.getPublicSlug();
54:         this.draft = event.isDraft();
55:         this.broadcast = event.isBroadcast();
56:         this.publishAt = event.getPublishAt();
57:         this.category = event.getCategory();
58:         this.authorId = event.getAuthorId();
59:         LOG.debug("Applied: 'BlogPostCreatedEvent' [{}]", event.getId());
60:     }
61:     @EventSourcingHandler
62:     public void on(BlogPostPublishedEvent event) {
63:         this.draft = Boolean.FALSE;
64:         this.publishAt = event.getPublishAt();
65:         LOG.debug("Applied: 'BlogPostPublishedEvent' [{}]", event.getId());
66:     }
67:     public static Logger getLog() {
68:         return LOG;
69:     }
70:     public String getId() {
71:         return id;
72:     }
73:     public String getTitle() {
74:         return title;
75:     }
76:     public String getRawContent() {
77:         return rawContent;
78:     }
79:     public String getPublicSlug() {
80:         return publicSlug;
81:     }
82:     public Boolean getDraft() {
83:         return draft;
84:     }
85:     public Boolean getBroadcast() {
86:         return broadcast;
87:     }
88:     public Date getPublishAt() {
89:         return publishAt;
90:     }
91:     public BlogPostCategory getCategory() {
92:         return category;
93:     }
94:     public String getAuthorId() {
95:         return authorId;
96:     }
97: }

 1: package com.idugalic.commandside.blog.web;
 2: import java.security.Principal;
 3: import javax.servlet.http.HttpServletResponse;
 4: import org.axonframework.commandhandling.gateway.CommandGateway;
 5: import org.slf4j.Logger;
 6: import org.slf4j.LoggerFactory;
 7: import org.springframework.beans.factory.annotation.Autowired;
 8: import org.springframework.http.HttpStatus;
 9: import org.springframework.http.MediaType;
10: import org.springframework.security.core.context.SecurityContextHolder;
11: import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.PathVariable;
12: import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.RequestBody;
13: import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.RequestMapping;
14: import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.RequestMethod;
15: import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.ResponseStatus;
16: import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.RestController;
17: import com.idugalic.commandside.blog.command.CreateBlogPostCommand;
18: import com.idugalic.commandside.blog.command.PublishBlogPostCommand;
19: import com.idugalic.common.model.AuditEntry;
20: @RestController
21: @RequestMapping(value = "/blogpostcommands")
22: public class BlogController {
23:     private static final Logger LOG = LoggerFactory.getLogger(BlogController.class);
24:     private String getCurrentUser() {
25:         if (SecurityContextHolder.getContext().getAuthentication() != null) {
26:             return SecurityContextHolder.getContext().getAuthentication().getName();
27:         }
28:         return null;
29:     }
30:     private AuditEntry createAudit() {
31:         return new AuditEntry(getCurrentUser());
32:     }
33:     @Autowired
34:     private CommandGateway commandGateway;
35:     @RequestMapping(method = RequestMethod.POST, consumes = MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON_VALUE)
36:     @ResponseStatus(value = HttpStatus.CREATED)
37:     public void create(@RequestBody CreateBlogPostRequest request, HttpServletResponse response, Principal principal) {
38:         LOG.debug(CreateBlogPostRequest.class.getSimpleName() + " request received");
39:         CreateBlogPostCommand command = new CreateBlogPostCommand(createAudit(), request.getTitle(),
40:                 request.getRawContent(), request.getPublicSlug(), request.getDraft(), request.getBroadcast(),
41:                 request.getPublishAt(), request.getCategory(), getCurrentUser());
42:         commandGateway.sendAndWait(command);
43:         LOG.debug(CreateBlogPostCommand.class.getSimpleName() + " sent to command gateway: Blog Post [{}] ", command.getId());
44:     }
45:     @RequestMapping(value = "/{id}/publishcommand", method = RequestMethod.POST, consumes = MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON_VALUE)
46:     @ResponseStatus(value = HttpStatus.ACCEPTED)
47:     public void publish(@PathVariable String id, @RequestBody PublishBlogPostRequest request, HttpServletResponse response, Principal principal) {
48:         LOG.debug(PublishBlogPostRequest.class.getSimpleName() + " request received");
49:         PublishBlogPostCommand command = new PublishBlogPostCommand(id, createAudit(), request.getPublishAt());
50:         commandGateway.sendAndWait(command);
51:         LOG.debug(PublishBlogPostCommand.class.getSimpleName() + " sent to command gateway: Blog Post [{}] ", command.getId());
52:     }
53: }

 16: # KIND, either express or implied.  See the License for the
 17: # specific language governing permissions and limitations
 18: # under the License.
 19: # ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 20: 
 21: # ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 22: # Maven2 Start Up Batch script
 23: #
 24: # Required ENV vars:
 25: # ------------------
 26: #   JAVA_HOME - location of a JDK home dir
 27: #
 28: # Optional ENV vars
 29: # -----------------
 30: #   M2_HOME - location of maven2's installed home dir
 31: #   MAVEN_OPTS - parameters passed to the Java VM when running Maven
 32: #     e.g. to debug Maven itself, use
 33: #       set MAVEN_OPTS=-Xdebug -Xrunjdwp:transport=dt_socket,server=y,suspend=y,address=8000
 34: #   MAVEN_SKIP_RC - flag to disable loading of mavenrc files
 35: # ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 36: 
 37: if [ -z "$MAVEN_SKIP_RC" ] ; then
 38: 
 39:   if [ -f /etc/mavenrc ] ; then
 40:     . /etc/mavenrc
 41:   fi
 42: 
 43:   if [ -f "$HOME/.mavenrc" ] ; then
 44:     . "$HOME/.mavenrc"
 45:   fi
 46: 
 47: fi
 48: 
 49: # OS specific support.  $var _must_ be set to either true or false.
 50: cygwin=false;
 51: darwin=false;
 52: mingw=false
 53: case "`uname`" in
 54:   CYGWIN*) cygwin=true ;;
 55:   MINGW*) mingw=true;;
 56:   Darwin*) darwin=true
 57:            #
 58:            # Look for the Apple JDKs first to preserve the existing behaviour, and then look
 59:            # for the new JDKs provided by Oracle.
 60:            #
 61:            if [ -z "$JAVA_HOME" ] && [ -L /System/Library/Frameworks/JavaVM.framework/Versions/CurrentJDK ] ; then
 62:              #
 63:              # Apple JDKs
 64:              #
 65:              export JAVA_HOME=/System/Library/Frameworks/JavaVM.framework/Versions/CurrentJDK/Home
 66:            fi
 67: 
 68:            if [ -z "$JAVA_HOME" ] && [ -L /System/Library/Java/JavaVirtualMachines/CurrentJDK ] ; then
 69:              #
 70:              # Apple JDKs
 71:              #
 72:              export JAVA_HOME=/System/Library/Java/JavaVirtualMachines/CurrentJDK/Contents/Home
 73:            fi
 74: 
 75:            if [ -z "$JAVA_HOME" ] && [ -L "/Library/Java/JavaVirtualMachines/CurrentJDK" ] ; then
 76:              #
 77:              # Oracle JDKs
 78:              #
 79:              export JAVA_HOME=/Library/Java/JavaVirtualMachines/CurrentJDK/Contents/Home
 80:            fi
 81: 
 82:            if [ -z "$JAVA_HOME" ] && [ -x "/usr/libexec/java_home" ]; then
 83:              #
 84:              # Apple JDKs
 85:              #
 86:              export JAVA_HOME=`/usr/libexec/java_home`
 87:            fi
 88:            ;;
 89: esac
 90: 
 91: if [ -z "$JAVA_HOME" ] ; then
 92:   if [ -r /etc/gentoo-release ] ; then
 93:     JAVA_HOME=`java-config --jre-home`
 94:   fi
 95: fi
 96: 
 97: if [ -z "$M2_HOME" ] ; then
 98:   ## resolve links - $0 may be a link to maven's home
 99:   PRG="$0"
100: 
101:   # need this for relative symlinks
102:   while [ -h "$PRG" ] ; do
103:     ls=`ls -ld "$PRG"`
104:     link=`expr "$ls" : '.*-> \(.*\)$'`
105:     if expr "$link" : '/.*' > /dev/null; then
106:       PRG="$link"
107:     else
108:       PRG="`dirname "$PRG"`/$link"
109:     fi
110:   done
111: 
112:   saveddir=`pwd`
113: 
114:   M2_HOME=`dirname "$PRG"`/..
115: 
116:   # make it fully qualified
117:   M2_HOME=`cd "$M2_HOME" && pwd`
118: 
119:   cd "$saveddir"
120:   # echo Using m2 at $M2_HOME
121: fi
122: 
123: # For Cygwin, ensure paths are in UNIX format before anything is touched
124: if $cygwin ; then
125:   [ -n "$M2_HOME" ] &&
126:     M2_HOME=`cygpath --unix "$M2_HOME"`
127:   [ -n "$JAVA_HOME" ] &&
128:     JAVA_HOME=`cygpath --unix "$JAVA_HOME"`
129:   [ -n "$CLASSPATH" ] &&
130:     CLASSPATH=`cygpath --path --unix "$CLASSPATH"`
131: fi
132: 
133: # For Migwn, ensure paths are in UNIX format before anything is touched
134: if $mingw ; then
135:   [ -n "$M2_HOME" ] &&
136:     M2_HOME="`(cd "$M2_HOME"; pwd)`"
137:   [ -n "$JAVA_HOME" ] &&
138:     JAVA_HOME="`(cd "$JAVA_HOME"; pwd)`"
139:   # TODO classpath?
140: fi
141: 
142: if [ -z "$JAVA_HOME" ]; then
143:   javaExecutable="`which javac`"
144:   if [ -n "$javaExecutable" ] && ! [ "`expr \"$javaExecutable\" : '\([^ ]*\)'`" = "no" ]; then
145:     # readlink(1) is not available as standard on Solaris 10.
146:     readLink=`which readlink`
147:     if [ ! `expr "$readLink" : '\([^ ]*\)'` = "no" ]; then
148:       if $darwin ; then
149:         javaHome="`dirname \"$javaExecutable\"`"
150:         javaExecutable="`cd \"$javaHome\" && pwd -P`/javac"
151:       else
152:         javaExecutable="`readlink -f \"$javaExecutable\"`"
153:       fi
154:       javaHome="`dirname \"$javaExecutable\"`"
155:       javaHome=`expr "$javaHome" : '\(.*\)/bin'`
156:       JAVA_HOME="$javaHome"
157:       export JAVA_HOME
158:     fi
159:   fi
160: fi
161: 
162: if [ -z "$JAVACMD" ] ; then
163:   if [ -n "$JAVA_HOME"  ] ; then
164:     if [ -x "$JAVA_HOME/jre/sh/java" ] ; then
165:       # IBM's JDK on AIX uses strange locations for the executables
166:       JAVACMD="$JAVA_HOME/jre/sh/java"
167:     else
168:       JAVACMD="$JAVA_HOME/bin/java"
169:     fi
170:   else
171:     JAVACMD="`which java`"
172:   fi
173: fi
174: 
175: if [ ! -x "$JAVACMD" ] ; then
176:   echo "Error: JAVA_HOME is not defined correctly." >&2
177:   echo "  We cannot execute $JAVACMD" >&2
178:   exit 1
179: fi
180: 
181: if [ -z "$JAVA_HOME" ] ; then
182:   echo "Warning: JAVA_HOME environment variable is not set."
183: fi
184: 
185: CLASSWORLDS_LAUNCHER=org.codehaus.plexus.classworlds.launcher.Launcher
186: 
187: # For Cygwin, switch paths to Windows format before running java
188: if $cygwin; then
189:   [ -n "$M2_HOME" ] &&
190:     M2_HOME=`cygpath --path --windows "$M2_HOME"`
191:   [ -n "$JAVA_HOME" ] &&
192:     JAVA_HOME=`cygpath --path --windows "$JAVA_HOME"`
193:   [ -n "$CLASSPATH" ] &&
194:     CLASSPATH=`cygpath --path --windows "$CLASSPATH"`
195: fi
196: 
197: # traverses directory structure from process work directory to filesystem root
198: # first directory with .mvn subdirectory is considered project base directory
199: find_maven_basedir() {
200:   local basedir=$(pwd)
201:   local wdir=$(pwd)
202:   while [ "$wdir" != '/' ] ; do
203:     if [ -d "$wdir"/.mvn ] ; then
204:       basedir=$wdir
205:       break
206:     fi
207:     wdir=$(cd "$wdir/.."; pwd)
208:   done
209:   echo "${basedir}"
210: }
211: 
212: # concatenates all lines of a file
213: concat_lines() {
214:   if [ -f "$1" ]; then
215:     echo "$(tr -s '\n' ' ' < "$1")"
216:   fi
217: }
218: 
219: export MAVEN_PROJECTBASEDIR=${MAVEN_BASEDIR:-$(find_maven_basedir)}
220: MAVEN_OPTS="$(concat_lines "$MAVEN_PROJECTBASEDIR/.mvn/jvm.config") $MAVEN_OPTS"
221: 
222: # Provide a "standardized" way to retrieve the CLI args that will
223: # work with both Windows and non-Windows executions.
224: MAVEN_CMD_LINE_ARGS="$MAVEN_CONFIG $@"
225: export MAVEN_CMD_LINE_ARGS
226: 
227: WRAPPER_LAUNCHER=org.apache.maven.wrapper.MavenWrapperMain
228: 
229: exec "$JAVACMD" \
230:   $MAVEN_OPTS \
231:   -classpath "$MAVEN_PROJECTBASEDIR/.mvn/wrapper/maven-wrapper.jar" \
232:   "-Dmaven.home=${M2_HOME}" "-Dmaven.multiModuleProjectDirectory=${MAVEN_PROJECTBASEDIR}" \
233:   ${WRAPPER_LAUNCHER} "$@"

 20: @REM ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 21: @REM Maven2 Start Up Batch script
 22: @REM
 23: @REM Required ENV vars:
 24: @REM JAVA_HOME - location of a JDK home dir
 25: @REM
 26: @REM Optional ENV vars
 27: @REM M2_HOME - location of maven2's installed home dir
 28: @REM MAVEN_BATCH_ECHO - set to 'on' to enable the echoing of the batch commands
 29: @REM MAVEN_BATCH_PAUSE - set to 'on' to wait for a key stroke before ending
 30: @REM MAVEN_OPTS - parameters passed to the Java VM when running Maven
 31: @REM     e.g. to debug Maven itself, use
 32: @REM set MAVEN_OPTS=-Xdebug -Xrunjdwp:transport=dt_socket,server=y,suspend=y,address=8000
 33: @REM MAVEN_SKIP_RC - flag to disable loading of mavenrc files
 34: @REM ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 35: 
 36: @REM Begin all REM lines with '@' in case MAVEN_BATCH_ECHO is 'on'
 37: @echo off
 38: @REM enable echoing my setting MAVEN_BATCH_ECHO to 'on'
 39: @if "%MAVEN_BATCH_ECHO%" == "on"  echo %MAVEN_BATCH_ECHO%
 40: 
 41: @REM set %HOME% to equivalent of $HOME
 42: if "%HOME%" == "" (set "HOME=%HOMEDRIVE%%HOMEPATH%")
 43: 
 44: @REM Execute a user defined script before this one
 45: if not "%MAVEN_SKIP_RC%" == "" goto skipRcPre
 46: @REM check for pre script, once with legacy .bat ending and once with .cmd ending
 47: if exist "%HOME%\mavenrc_pre.bat" call "%HOME%\mavenrc_pre.bat"
 48: if exist "%HOME%\mavenrc_pre.cmd" call "%HOME%\mavenrc_pre.cmd"
 49: :skipRcPre
 50: 
 51: @setlocal
 52: 
 53: set ERROR_CODE=0
 54: 
 55: @REM To isolate internal variables from possible post scripts, we use another setlocal
 56: @setlocal
 57: 
 58: @REM ==== START VALIDATION ====
 59: if not "%JAVA_HOME%" == "" goto OkJHome
 60: 
 61: echo.
 62: echo Error: JAVA_HOME not found in your environment. >&2
 63: echo Please set the JAVA_HOME variable in your environment to match the >&2
 64: echo location of your Java installation. >&2
 65: echo.
 66: goto error
 67: 
 68: :OkJHome
 69: if exist "%JAVA_HOME%\bin\java.exe" goto init
 70: 
 71: echo.
 72: echo Error: JAVA_HOME is set to an invalid directory. >&2
 73: echo JAVA_HOME = "%JAVA_HOME%" >&2
 74: echo Please set the JAVA_HOME variable in your environment to match the >&2
 75: echo location of your Java installation. >&2
 76: echo.
 77: goto error
 78: 
 79: @REM ==== END VALIDATION ====
 80: 
 81: :init
 82: 
 83: set MAVEN_CMD_LINE_ARGS=%*
 84: 
 85: @REM Find the project base dir, i.e. the directory that contains the folder ".mvn".
 86: @REM Fallback to current working directory if not found.
 87: 
 88: set MAVEN_PROJECTBASEDIR=%MAVEN_BASEDIR%
 89: IF NOT "%MAVEN_PROJECTBASEDIR%"=="" goto endDetectBaseDir
 90: 
 91: set EXEC_DIR=%CD%
 92: set WDIR=%EXEC_DIR%
 93: :findBaseDir
 94: IF EXIST "%WDIR%"\.mvn goto baseDirFound
 95: cd ..
 96: IF "%WDIR%"=="%CD%" goto baseDirNotFound
 97: set WDIR=%CD%
 98: goto findBaseDir
 99: 
100: :baseDirFound
101: set MAVEN_PROJECTBASEDIR=%WDIR%
102: cd "%EXEC_DIR%"
103: goto endDetectBaseDir
104: 
105: :baseDirNotFound
106: set MAVEN_PROJECTBASEDIR=%EXEC_DIR%
107: cd "%EXEC_DIR%"
108: 
109: :endDetectBaseDir
110: 
111: IF NOT EXIST "%MAVEN_PROJECTBASEDIR%\.mvn\jvm.config" goto endReadAdditionalConfig
112: 
113: @setlocal EnableExtensions EnableDelayedExpansion
114: for /F "usebackq delims=" %%a in ("%MAVEN_PROJECTBASEDIR%\.mvn\jvm.config") do set JVM_CONFIG_MAVEN_PROPS=!JVM_CONFIG_MAVEN_PROPS! %%a
115: @endlocal & set JVM_CONFIG_MAVEN_PROPS=%JVM_CONFIG_MAVEN_PROPS%
116: 
117: :endReadAdditionalConfig
118: 
119: SET MAVEN_JAVA_EXE="%JAVA_HOME%\bin\java.exe"
120: 
121: set WRAPPER_JAR="".\.mvn\wrapper\maven-wrapper.jar""
122: set WRAPPER_LAUNCHER=org.apache.maven.wrapper.MavenWrapperMain
123: 
124: %MAVEN_JAVA_EXE% %JVM_CONFIG_MAVEN_PROPS% %MAVEN_OPTS% %MAVEN_DEBUG_OPTS% -classpath %WRAPPER_JAR% "-Dmaven.multiModuleProjectDirectory=%MAVEN_PROJECTBASEDIR%" %WRAPPER_LAUNCHER% %MAVEN_CMD_LINE_ARGS%
125: if ERRORLEVEL 1 goto error
126: goto end
127: 
128: :error
129: set ERROR_CODE=1
130: 
131: :end
132: @endlocal & set ERROR_CODE=%ERROR_CODE%
133: 
134: if not "%MAVEN_SKIP_RC%" == "" goto skipRcPost
135: @REM check for post script, once with legacy .bat ending and once with .cmd ending
136: if exist "%HOME%\mavenrc_post.bat" call "%HOME%\mavenrc_post.bat"
137: if exist "%HOME%\mavenrc_post.cmd" call "%HOME%\mavenrc_post.cmd"
138: :skipRcPost
139: 
140: @REM pause the script if MAVEN_BATCH_PAUSE is set to 'on'
141: if "%MAVEN_BATCH_PAUSE%" == "on" pause
142: 
143: if "%MAVEN_TERMINATE_CMD%" == "on" exit %ERROR_CODE%
144: 
145: exit /B %ERROR_CODE%

 5: import org.springframework.amqp.rabbit.connection.ConnectionFactory;
 6: import org.springframework.beans.factory.annotation.Autowired;
 7: import org.springframework.beans.factory.annotation.Value;
 8: import org.springframework.context.annotation.Bean;
 9: import org.springframework.context.annotation.Configuration;

13:     @Value("${spring.rabbitmq.hostname}")
14:     private String hostname;
15:     @Value("${spring.rabbitmq.username}")
16:     private String username;
17:     @Value("${spring.rabbitmq.password}")
18:     private String password;
19:     @Value("${axon.amqp.exchange}")
20:     private String exchangeName;
21:     @Bean
22:     FanoutExchange eventBusExchange() {
23:         return new FanoutExchange(exchangeName, true, false);
24:     }
25:     @Profile("!cloud")
26:     @Bean
27:     ConnectionFactory connectionFactory() {
28:         CachingConnectionFactory connectionFactory = new CachingConnectionFactory(hostname);
29:         connectionFactory.setUsername(username);
30:         connectionFactory.setPassword(password);
31:         return connectionFactory;
32:     }
33:     @Autowired
34:     void rabbitAdmin(AmqpAdmin admin, FanoutExchange eventBusExchange) {
35:         admin.declareExchange(eventBusExchange);
36:     }
